about: Labelled brief pairs for the suggestion counter's similarity measure (spec 2026-11-28-research-layer.md §6.5). `same` = the two briefs are the same kind of work. Written before the measure existed; never edited to make a threshold pass.

a.title: Write this week's release notes
a.brief: Write the release notes for this week. Go through the pull requests merged since last Friday and group them into new features, fixes and internal changes. Keep it short and in plain language, the readers are customers, not developers.

b.title: Draft the changelog for v2.3
b.brief: We are about to tag v2.3. Draft the changelog entry from everything merged since v2.2: user-facing changes first, then fixes. Leave out dependency bumps and anything that only touched tests.

a.title: Add a Playwright test for login
a.brief: There is no browser test for logging in. Add a Playwright spec that signs in with a valid account, checks the dashboard shows, and checks a wrong password shows the error message. Put it next to the other specs in tests/e2e.

b.title: Cover the sign-in flow with an end-to-end test
b.brief: Please write an end-to-end test of the sign-in flow using the browser test runner we already have. Happy path and a bad-credentials case are enough. It should run in CI with the rest of the e2e suite.

a.title: Fix the flaky upload test
a.brief: The upload spec fails about one run in five on CI and never locally. Find out why it is flaky and make it deterministic. Don't just add a retry.

b.title: Stabilise the intermittent failure in the file upload tests
b.brief: tests/upload.test.ts sometimes times out on the build server but passes on my machine. Track down the race behind it and fix it so the suite stops failing at random.

a.title: Add a dark mode toggle to settings
a.brief: Users want to pick a dark appearance. Add a switch in the Settings page that turns dark mode on and off, remember the choice, and apply it to every screen. Default follows the system.

b.title: Let people choose the theme from preferences
b.brief: Add a theme choice (light, dark, follow system) to the preferences screen. The pick has to survive a restart and take effect straight away without reloading the window.

a.title: Add a billing email column to accounts
a.brief: Accounts need a separate billing email. Add a nullable column to the accounts table, backfill it from the owner's email, and update the model. Write the migration so it can be rolled back.

b.title: Migration: store the invoice contact on the customers table
b.brief: We need somewhere to keep the invoice contact address for each customer. Create a schema change adding that field, fill existing rows from the main contact, and make the down step work.

a.title: Upgrade React to version 19
a.brief: We are on React 18. Upgrade to 19, fix whatever breaks (deprecated APIs, the types, the test utilities), and make sure the app still builds and the tests pass.

b.title: Bump react and react-dom to the new major
b.brief: The react packages are a major version behind. Move them up, sort out the breaking changes in our components and typings, and confirm the build and test suite are green again.

a.title: Update the README with setup steps
a.brief: The README still describes the old setup. Rewrite the getting-started section: prerequisites, install, environment variables, how to start the dev server and run the tests. Test the steps on a clean checkout.

b.title: Document how to install and run the project locally
b.brief: A new teammate couldn't get the project running. Write clear instructions for installing it and running it on their own machine, including the env file and the database, and put them in the main readme.

a.title: Add an endpoint that lists a user's invoices
a.brief: Add GET /users/:id/invoices. It returns the invoices of that user, newest first, with pagination. Only the user themselves or an admin may call it. Add tests.

b.title: New route returning the invoices for a customer
b.brief: Please expose the invoices of a given customer over the API: a read-only route, paginated, sorted with the latest on top, protected so that only the owner or an administrator can see them. Cover it with tests.

a.title: Rename the Session type to Conversation everywhere
a.brief: The code calls them sessions but the product says conversations. Rename the Session type, its fields and the files, across the whole repo, without changing behaviour. The tests must still pass.

b.title: Refactor: use the word conversation instead of session throughout
b.brief: Do a codebase-wide rename so that what we call a session in code becomes a conversation, matching the product language. Types, variables, file names and comments. No behaviour change.

a.title: CI is failing on the lint step
a.brief: Every pull request is red because the lint job fails on the build server. Reproduce it, find the cause and fix the pipeline so lint passes again.

b.title: Repair the broken GitHub Actions workflow
b.brief: The eslint job in our workflow errors out before it even lints anything, so all PRs are blocked. Work out what changed in the workflow or the runner and get the checks passing.

a.title: The dashboard loads slowly, find out why
a.brief: The dashboard takes around six seconds to show data. Profile it, find where the time goes (queries, bundle, rendering) and fix the biggest cause. Give me before and after numbers.

b.title: Profile the home page and speed it up
b.brief: Our home screen is sluggish: it needs about 6 s to become usable. Measure what is slow, fix the main offender and tell me how much faster it got.

a.title: Translate the onboarding screens to Spanish
a.brief: Add a Spanish version of the onboarding flow. Extract the strings that are still hard-coded, create the es locale file, and make the language follow the browser setting.

b.title: Add Spanish strings for the first-run flow
b.brief: We want the first-run experience available in Spanish. Pull the remaining literal text into the translation files, provide the Spanish copy and pick the language from the user's system.

a.title: App crashes when opening an empty project
a.brief: Opening a project folder with no files throws an unhandled exception and the window goes blank. Reproduce it, fix the cause and add a regression test.

b.title: Fix the exception on a project that has no files
b.brief: If somebody opens a project that is empty, the app dies with an error. Find out why, make it show an empty state instead, and write a test so it can't come back.

a.title: Check the forms for accessibility problems
a.brief: Go through the signup and checkout forms with the keyboard and a screen reader. List and fix the problems: labels, focus order, error announcements, contrast.

b.title: Audit keyboard and screen reader support on the signup page
b.brief: Test the registration and payment pages without a mouse and with VoiceOver. Fix whatever blocks a user: missing names for inputs, bad tab order, errors that are not announced.

a.title: Add logging around the payment webhook
a.brief: We can't tell why some payment webhooks fail. Add structured logs around the webhook handler: the event id, the outcome and the error, without logging card data.

b.title: Instrument the Stripe callback so failures show up
b.brief: When the Stripe callback fails we learn about it from customers. Add log lines and an error report in that handler: event identifier, result, exception. Never write sensitive payment details.

a.title: Write a script to export customers to CSV
a.brief: Support needs a one-off script that exports every customer (name, email, plan, created date) to a CSV file. It should stream, since there are a few hundred thousand rows.

b.title: A command that dumps all users into a spreadsheet file
b.brief: Please make a small command-line tool that writes all users with their email, subscription and signup date into a file that Excel can open. The table is big, so don't load it all in memory.

a.title: Rewrite the landing page hero copy
a.brief: The hero section on the landing page reads like a feature list. Rewrite the headline, the subheading and the button label so they lead with the benefit. Give me three options.

b.title: Refresh the headline and subtitle on the home page
b.brief: The top section of the marketing home page is dull. Come up with better text for the main title, the line below it and the call-to-action, focused on what the customer gains. Three variants please.

a.title: Write the release notes for 4.1
a.brief: Write release notes for version 4.1 from the merged PRs. Sections: highlights, improvements, bug fixes. Link each item to its PR.

b.title: Summarise what shipped this month for the changelog
b.brief: Collect everything we merged this month and turn it into a changelog post: the highlights on top, then smaller improvements and fixes, each with a link to the pull request.

a.title: Add e2e coverage for checkout
a.brief: Checkout has no end-to-end test. Write one that adds an item to the cart, pays with the test card, and checks the confirmation page and the order email.

b.title: Playwright test for the purchase flow
b.brief: Write a browser test of buying something: put a product in the basket, complete payment using the sandbox card, and verify the order confirmation. It should run with the other specs.

a.title: Fix failing snapshot tests after the header redesign
a.brief: The new header broke twenty snapshot tests. Look at each diff, confirm it is the intended change, update the snapshots and make sure no real regression is hidden in there.

b.title: Update the broken jest snapshots, the navbar tests are red
b.brief: After the navigation bar redesign a pile of component snapshot tests fail. Review the differences, regenerate the ones that are expected and flag anything that looks like a genuine bug.

b.brief: The pricing page copy is confusing. Rewrite the plan descriptions so the differences are obvious, and propose a better name for the middle plan.

a.brief: Queries on the events table by date are slow. Add an index on created_at with a migration that can be rolled back, and check the query plan afterwards.

b.brief: The modals trap nothing: focus escapes, Escape doesn't close, and screen readers don't announce them. Fix the shared modal component.

a.brief: Profile page throws 'cannot read properties of null' when the user has no avatar image. Reproduce, fix it with a sensible default, and add a test.

b.brief: The transactional emails exist in English and Spanish. Add Portuguese versions of the welcome and receipt emails.

a.brief: The CSV importer uses 3 GB for a 200 MB file. Find out why and make it stream. Report the peak memory before and after.

b.brief: Write a contributing guide: how we branch, how to run checks, how reviews work and what we expect in a pull request description.

a.brief: Add GET /healthz that returns 200 when the database and the queue are reachable and 503 otherwise. Tests please.
